note: Padlock's locks, built by tools/build_padlock.py from wordfreq's words (Robyn Speer, CC-BY-SA 4.0, https://github.com/rspeer/wordfreq), pruned at build time by the LibreOffice Hunspell dictionaries and the LDNOOBW list. `dials` top to bottom, `start` the window as dealt, `words` every word the dials spell, `fair` those the bulb and the fewest count on, `min` the fewest fair words that light every letter, `shown` accents.
